FB12-069.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 card with ≪God of Destruction≫ in its special traits from your hand to your energy.

FB12-010.name: Son Goten
FB12-010.text:
[On Play] If you have a <Fate Transcending Generations> in your Battle Area, your Leader gets +1 Ki.
[When Attacking] Discard 1 card from your hand: Add up to 1 Extra with <Kamehameha> in its card name from your Drop to your hand.

FB12-011.name: Son Gohan: Adolescence
FB12-011.text: [Activate:Main] pay 1 energy, place this card into your Drop: If your <Son Goten> Leader has 3 or more Ki, draw 1 card. Then, play up to 1 <Son Gohan: Adolescence> with a cost of 3 from your hand.

FB12-014.name: Trunks: Youth
FB12-014.text: [On Play] Switch 1 of your Battle Cards with 5000 power in your Battle Area to Rest Mode: If you have a <Fate Transcending Generations> in your Battle Area, your Leader gets +1 Ki.

FB12-018.name: Vegeta
FB12-018.text: [When Attacking] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with 10000 power or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

FB12-029.name: Son Goku
FB12-029.text: [On Play] Place the top card of your deck into your Drop: If your Leader is <Son Goku>, draw 1 card.

FB12-030.name: Son Goku
FB12-030.text:
[Evolve] pay 1 energy: <Son Goku>
[When Attacking] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and reduce its cost by 1 for the turn.

FB12-050.name: Arack
FB12-050.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

FB12-058.name: Champa
FB12-058.text: [Activate:Main] Place this card into your Drop: If your Leader has ≪God of Destruction≫ in its special traits and your card with ≪God of Destruction≫ in its special traits has KO'd one of your opponent's Battle Cards during this turn, draw 2 cards.

FB12-075.name: Vados
FB12-075.text: [On Play] Discard 1 Extra from your hand: If your Leader is <Whis>, draw 2 cards.

FB12-079.name: Cucatail
FB12-079.text:
[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.

FB12-113.name: Frieza
FB12-113.text:
[On Play] Draw 1 card. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
[Activate:Main] [Once Per Turn] KO 1 <Sorbet> in your Battle Area or 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 in your Battle Area: If your Leader is <Golden Frieza>, increase the cost of this card by 3 for the turn.

FB12-034.name: Son Goku
FB12-034.text:
[On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goku/Vegeta> or <Vegito>, choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and reduce its cost by 1 for the turn.
[Activate:Main] [Once Per Turn] pay 1 energy: If there are no cards under this card, and you have <Vegeta> and <Potara> in your Drop, place 1 <Vegeta> and 1 <Potara> from your Drop under this card.

FB12-046.name: Vegeta
FB12-046.text:
[On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goku/Vegeta> or <Vegito>, draw 1 card.
[Activate:Main] [Once Per Turn] pay 1 energy, discard 1 card from your hand: If there are no cards under this card, and you have <Son Goku> and <Potara> in your Drop, place 1 <Son Goku> and 1 <Potara> from your Drop under this card.

FB12-047.name: Vegito
FB12-047.text:
[Evolve] pay 0 energy: <Son Goku> or <Vegeta> with a <Potara> under them.
[When Attacking] Place 3 cards from under this card into their owner's Drop: Add up to 1 <Son Goku>, or up to 1 <Vegeta>, or up to 1 Extra—all with a cost of 1—from your Drop to your hand.

FB12-019.name: Vegeta
FB12-019.text:
[On Play] If your Leader is <Vegeta>, choose up to 1 Battle Card with ≪Saiyan≫ in its special traits in your Battle Area and it can attack Active Mode Battle Cards in your opponent's Battle Area during this turn.
[When Attacking] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.

FB12-027.name: Gotenks
FB12-027.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has ≪Saiyan≫ in its special traits, add up to 1 card with a cost of 3 or less and both ≪Saiyan≫ and ≪Earthling≫ in its special traits from your Drop to your hand.
[When Attacking] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and reduce its cost by 1 for the turn.

FB12-035.name: Son Goten/Trunks: Youth
FB12-035.text: [On Play] Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 2 cards from your hand.

FB12-066.name: Majin Buu: Evil
FB12-066.text: [Activate:Main] [Once Per Turn] Place 1 Battle Card with ≪Majin≫ in its special traits from your hand under <Demonic Maze> in your Battle Area: Draw 1 card.

FB12-067.name: Majin Buu: Evil
FB12-067.text:
[Evolve] pay 1 energy: <Majin Buu: Evil> with a cost of 2 or 3.
[On Play] Place a total of 2 cards from under your cards with ≪Majin≫ in their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop: Add up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 and ≪Majin≫ in its special traits from your Drop to your hand.

FB12-068.name: Majin Buu: Kid
FB12-068.text:
[Evolve] pay 1 energy: <Majin Buu: Evil> with a cost of 3 or 4.
[Activate:Main] Place this card into your Drop: If your Leader has ≪Majin≫ in its special traits, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 7 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

FB12-084.name: Son Goku
FB12-084.text: [Activate:Main] pay 2 energy, place this card into your Drop: If your Leader is <Gogeta>, choose up to 1 card with [Evolve] and ≪Another World≫ in its special traits in your Battle Area and switch it to Active Mode. Then, you can't activate the [Activate:Main] of <Son Goku> for the turn.

FB12-085.name: Son Goku/Vegeta
FB12-085.text:
[Permanent] If your Leader is <Gogeta> or <Son Goku/Vegeta>, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 2.
[On Play] Reveal 1 <Veku> from your hand: Draw 1 card.

FB12-087.name: Paikuhan
FB12-087.text:
[Permanent] If <Son Goku/Vegeta> in your Battle Area is removed from the Battle Area by your opponent, you may KO this card instead.
[On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goku/Vegeta> and you have 1 <Paikuhan> in your Battle Area, switch 2 of your energy to Active Mode.

unparsed: If <Son Goku/Vegeta> in your Battle Area is removed from the Battle Area by your opponent, you may KO this card instead.

FB12-108.name: Trunks: Youth
FB12-108.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 3 or more Ki, add up to 1 <Vegeta> with a cost of 4 or less from your Drop to your hand.

FB12-109.name: Babidi
FB12-109.text: [On Play] Switch 1 <Wicked Soul Discovered> in your Battle Area to Active Mode: Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with ≪Wicked Soul≫ in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FB12-118.name: Vegeta
FB12-118.text: [When Attacking] If your Leader has 3 or more Ki, this card gets +20000 power for the battle.

FB12-017.name: Bulma
FB12-017.text: [Activate:Main] Place this card into your Drop: If your <Vegeta> Leader is awakened, play up to 1 <Son Goku> and up to 1 <Vegeta>—both with a cost of 1—from your hand. Then, you can't activate the [Activate:Main] of <Bulma> for the turn.

FB12-056.name: Shenron
FB12-056.text:
[Permanent] This card can't attack.
[Activate:Main] Switch this card to Rest Mode: Add up to 2 cards from your hand to your energy. Then, draw 2 cards.

FB12-062.name: Beerus
FB12-062.text: [On Play] Your opponent KO's 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less in their Battle Area. Then, if a Battle Card with a cost of 1 or less was KO'd by this skill, add the top card of your deck to your energy in Rest Mode.

FB12-076.name: Whis
FB12-076.text:
[Permanent] If you have 5 or more Extras with ≪Angel≫ in their special traits in your Drop, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 2.
[End of Your Turn] If your Leader is <Whis>, switch this card to Active Mode.

FB12-045.name: Vegeta
FB12-045.text:
[On Play] Place the top 2 cards of your deck into your Drop.
[When Attacking] Choose up to 1 <Son Goku> with a cost of 1 in your Battle Area and it gets +1 Ki. Then, if you have a total of 5 or more Ki in your Battle Area, your <Son Goku> Leader's original power becomes 25000 until the end of your opponent's next turn.

unparsed: Then, if you have a total of 5 or more Ki in your Battle Area, your <Son Goku> Leader's original power becomes 25000 until the end of your opponent's next turn.

FB12-077.name: Whis
FB12-077.text:
[barrier]
[When Attacking] Discard 1 card with ≪Angel≫ in its special traits from your hand: Draw 1 card. Then, if your Leader is <Whis>, at the end of the turn, switch this card to Active Mode.

FB12-117.name: Frieza
FB12-117.text:
[Evolve] pay 1 energy: <Frieza> with a cost of 4.
[On Play] Place the top 3 cards of your deck into your Drop and draw 1 card. Then, if this card was played by your Leader's skill, choose all Battle Cards with original costs of 5 or less in the Battle Areas other than this card and KO them.

FP-104.name: Son Goku

[Evolve] pay 2 energy: <Son Goku>

[When Attacking] If this card was played from your energy this turn, add the top card of your deck to your energy in Rest Mode.

FB12-012.text: [On Play] Choose all Battle Cards with ≪Earthling≫ in their special traits in your Battle Area and they get +5000 power for the turn.

FB12-015.name: Piccolo
FB12-015.text:
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and it gets -5000 power for the turn.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have a <Son Gohan: Adolescence> with a cost of 2 or more in your Battle Area, switch this card to Active Mode.

FB12-071.name: Liquiir

FB12-082.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and switch it to Rest Mode.
